pr_body:
When merging trace files, we sometimes left open read streams from the zip, which prevents it from being removed.

Fixes #27286.

issue_context.title: [BUG] Error: EPERM or EBUSY related to traces when run all the tests
issue_context.body:
<!-- ⚠️⚠️ Do not delete this template ⚠️⚠️ -->

<!-- 🧪 Test using the latest Playwright release to see if your issue has already been fixed -->
<!-- 💡 Provide enough information for us to be able to reproduce your issue locally -->

### System info
- Playwright Version: [v1.38.1]
- Operating System: Windows 10
- Browser: Chromium

**Config file**

```js
// playwright.config.ts
.......
 {
      name: 'local-chromium',
      use: {
        ...devices['Desktop Chrome'],
        trace: 'on',
      },
    },
.......
```

**Steps**
- Update playwright to the latest version,
- Run all the tests (around 103 with UI, API) using the following command:
npx playwright test --workers 1 --project=local-chromium

**Expected**
failed tests are marked as failed, passed as passed

**Actual**
Some tests are failing with the following issues in afterAll (but with no specific issue place in logs) without any visible reasons

`Error: tracing.stopChunk: EBUSY: resource busy or locked, copyfile 'C:\PW\test-results\.playwright-artifacts-2\traces\f36fdf6c8429426f1a7f-da1a60ab78e80e3d8045-context8.network' -> 'C:\PW\test-results\.playwright-artifacts-2\traces\f36fdf6c8429426f1a7f-da1a60ab78e80e3d8045-context9.network'`

or

`Error: EPERM: operation not permitted, rename C:\PW\test-results\test-name-local-chromium\trace.zip' -> 'C:\PW\test-results\test-name-local-chromium\trace.zip.tmp'`
comments:
Do you have an antivirus software on the machine? If so, it most likely opens the file for scanning and breaks the rename operation. You can try and add an exception for the playwright folder. If there is no antivirus, there is someone else holding an open handle to the file, you can try to use [handle.exe](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/downloads/handle) to print all programs that has the file open

```cmd
handle.exe 'C:\PW\test-results\test-name-local-chromium\trace.zip'
```

but it will only work if the other program keeps the file open. It's hard to tell who exactly breaks tampers with the filesystem operations without a repro.

> Do you have an antivirus software on the machine? If so, it most likely opens the file for scanning and breaks the rename operation. You can try and add an exception for the playwright folder. If there is no antivirus, there is someone else holding an open handle to the file, you can try to use [handle.exe](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/downloads/handle) to print all programs that has the file open.
> 
> ```batchfile
> handle.exe 'C:\PW\test-results\test-name-local-chromium\trace.zip'
> ```
> 
> but it will only work if the other program keeps the file open. It's hard to tell who exactly breaks tampers with the filesystem operations without a repro.

handle.exe doesn't work, it returns No matching handles found. after some delay. 
Anti virus is default windows defender. Previous version of Playwright (1.37) worked well. Test is green if I run it in debug mode via VSCode, but red if I run it using command npx playwright test -g 'name' --project=local-chromium or in UI mode.

So I believe it's related to workflows of playwright reporting. Will try to get more details.

> @yury-s is there a DEBUG env var key (Like this one for browser) which could give more info logs related to reporting?

Yes, there is a bunch of debug logging. vars which let you debug playwright internals but in this case it is a problem with a trace file on windows filesystem and there is no logging for that in playwright.

> Anti virus is default windows defender. 

Can you try disabling it and see if the problem persists? There is also Windows Search Indexer that can have the same effect, try disabling that too.

Disabling of these features doesn't help and the result would be different I believe. This issue is reproducible each time with some tests and not reproducible with other. In case of issues related to Windows it would be floating issue I believe..
We need a repro to help you with this, it seems that there is something specific to your environment that causes the problem.

I can confirm that this is fixed for our use cases in the alpha release: [1.40.0-alpha-oct-20-2023](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@playwright/test/v/1.40.0-alpha-oct-20-2023) .

Thanks everyone!
